skill.name: use-form-5500-mcp
skill.description: Connect and use the PlanProvider.Pro Form 5500 MCP from Claude, Codex, Cursor, or another MCP-compatible agent. Use when a user wants to find a company retirement plan, search retirement plan providers, retrieve a provider profile, identify a plan's service providers, or ground Form 5500 research in PlanProvider.Pro source records.
skill.summary: Research Form 5500 plans and retirement service providers through the authenticated PlanProvider.Pro MCP.
skill.author: oil-can-man

remediation.suggestion: Document endpoint ownership, OAuth scopes, data retention, and privacy terms, and provide a stable PlanProvider.Pro domain for connection.

content.value_statement: Retirement plan research often requires matching sponsors, filings, and service providers across source records. This skill queries PlanProvider.Pro and returns grounded results with canonical links.
actual_capabilities: Searches indexed Form 5500 plans by company or sponsor name.
Returns sponsor, plan, EIN, plan number, participant, asset, and source-link fields when available.
Searches retirement plan providers by firm, provider type, or state.
Retrieves PlanProvider.Pro provider profiles from known URL slugs.
Guides source-grounded answers that distinguish MCP fields from linked record details.
limitations: Requires an MCP-compatible client, network access, PlanProvider.Pro OAuth, and an eligible account tier.
Free and provider accounts may receive limited rows or omit signer details.
Filing-derived records may not describe current provider relationships.
Some service-provider details require opening the canonical PlanProvider.Pro record.

use_cases.title: Verify a Sponsor Plan
use_cases.description: Find matching Form 5500 records and compare plan identifiers before selecting a result.

use_cases.title: Research Service Providers
use_cases.description: Search auditors, advisors, administrators, insurers, or ERISA attorneys by specialty and geography.

use_cases.title: Ground Compliance Research
use_cases.description: Support a filing-based answer with relevant context and canonical source links.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Company Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Find Form 5500 plans for [company]. List matching sponsors, plan names, EINs, plan numbers, participants, assets, and source links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner lookup for a known company

prompt_templates.title: Search Providers
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for [provider type] firms in [state]. Summarize each matching firm and include its PlanProvider.Pro source link.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Plan Matches
prompt_templates.prompt: Find plans for [sponsor name]. Compare possible matches using plan name, EIN, plan number, participants, assets, and filing context.

prompt_templates.title: Trace a Provider Relationship
prompt_templates.prompt: Research the [provider role] for [company] and [plan]. Separate MCP fields from linked record details and state the filing period.

output_examples.input: Find the retirement plan for Northstar Manufacturing.
output_examples.output: One matching sponsor record was found. The result lists the plan name, EIN, plan number, participants, assets, filing period, and canonical source link.

output_examples.input: Find retirement plan auditors in Ohio.
output_examples.output: The provider search returns matching audit firms in Ohio. Each result includes available profile details and a PlanProvider.Pro source link.

output_examples.input: Who is the advisor for a named 401(k) plan?
output_examples.output: The answer identifies the advisor only when the linked filing-derived record lists that relationship. It also states the filing period and source URL.

best_practices: Use the narrowest MCP tool and provide a precise sponsor, provider type, state, or EIN.
Resolve multiple matches with plan name, EIN, plan number, participants, assets, and filing period.
Include canonical links and label details obtained from linked records separately.
anti_patterns: Do not infer a current provider relationship from an older filing.
Do not invent missing identifiers, participant counts, asset values, credentials, or provider details.
Do not select an ambiguous company match without comparing available plan identifiers.

faq.question: What data can this skill search?
faq.answer: It searches indexed Form 5500 plan records and retirement provider profiles available through PlanProvider.Pro.

faq.question: Does this skill require an account?
faq.answer: Yes. The remote MCP server uses PlanProvider.Pro OAuth, and available results depend on the signed-in account tier.

faq.question: Which clients are supported?
faq.answer: The instructions apply to Claude, Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and other clients that support remote MCP connections.

faq.question: Can it identify a plan service provider?
faq.answer: Yes, when the MCP result or linked PlanProvider.Pro record lists the provider relationship.

faq.question: Are the relationships current?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. Form 5500 records are filing-derived and should be presented with their applicable filing period.

faq.question: What happens when no plan matches?
faq.answer: The response should report no match and request another sponsor name, state, or EIN.
